caption:
The second ask after fine

My aunt asks how the trip was, hears fine, and asks again. Then she got the whole story.

Fine is often a reflex, not an answer, and the second ask is where the real one tends to show up.

For whoever asks one more time after fine.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. A bubble from the black one says how was the trip? and the blue one answers fine. The black one tilts and asks again, really? The blue one's eyes go wide, it pulses and says so, listen, then its eyes turn happy and the black one's do too. The text stays: me asking again after fine. The last card: Choose friction.
